an3.97:1.1: aṅganteva saṅkhayaṁ → aṅgantveva saṅkhaṁ (bj); aṅgantveva saṁkhaṁ (sya-all) | bhadro assājānīyo → bhaddo assājāniyo (sya-all)
an3.97:1.4: aṅganteva saṅkhyaṁ → aṅgantveva saṅkhaṁ (bj, sya-all) | tīhi aṅgehi → tīhaṅgehi (sya-all) | bhadro assājānīyo → bhaddo assājāniyo (sya-all)
an3.97:3.2: āraddhavīriyo viharati → āraddhaviriyo hoti (bj) | pahānāya → pahāṇāya (bj) | āraddhavīriyo → āraddhaviriyo (sya-all)
